# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository contains Dart practice code covering object-oriented programming concepts such as constructors, factories, generics, mixins, abstract classes, and asynchronous programming.

## Preferred Model

Use **claude-sonnet-4-5** (Claude Sonnet) as the preferred model for AI assistance in this repository.

## Code Style

- Follow Dart style guidelines and conventions.
- Use `dart format` to format code.
- Prefer clear, readable code with meaningful variable and class names.
- Use strong typing and avoid `dynamic` where possible.

## Context

- All files are standalone Dart programs with a `main()` entry point unless otherwise noted.
- Concepts practiced include: OOP (classes, inheritance, interfaces, mixins), generics, factory constructors, named constructors, async/await, and static members.
